any_page_ideas: Change the color theme, such as "make it purple" or "a warm sunset gradient"
Change the headline, the wording and the picture at the top
Add tabs so you can switch between two views of the same page
Show one clear number you can check yourself, such as a count or a progress bar

starters.title: Project Planner
starters.summary: Day columns with a + to add tasks, drag between days, tick when done, and a progress bar.
starters.manual_check: 4 tasks to start and 1 is ticked, so the bar reads 1 of 4 done. Tick one more: 2 of 4.
later_ideas: Rename the columns to your own stages, such as To Do, In Progress, Review and Done
Add a chart showing how much work is left in each stage
Add an owner name and a due date to each card
Give each card a priority chip and make the urgent ones stand out
Add tabs to switch between every task and only the unfinished ones
starters.try_it: Try it: press + to add something, drag it, or remove it.

starters.title: Calendar
starters.summary: A month grid with a + on every day, notes you can drag between days, and Month, Week and Workdays views.
starters.manual_check: 3 notes to start: today, tomorrow and in three days. Add one and the count shows 4 notes planned.
later_ideas: Color each note by type, such as meeting, deadline or day off
Add a start time to each note and keep each day in time order
Add an Agenda tab beside Month, Week and Workdays
Show how many notes each week has
Mark your country's public holidays so they stand out from your own notes
starters.try_it: Try it: press + on a day to add a note, drag it to another day, or switch to Week.

starters.title: Ideas Wall
starters.summary: Colorful sticky notes: + to add an idea, drag to put the best first, and x to remove.
starters.manual_check: 3 ideas to start. Add one: 4 ideas. Remove one: back to 3.
later_ideas: Add a vote button with a count, and sort the best idea to the front
Group the ideas into themes with tabs
Add a search box that filters the notes as you type
Let each note have its own color
Show the top idea in a highlighted panel above the wall
starters.try_it: Try it: press + to pin an idea, drag the best one to the front, or remove one.

starters.title: Weather
starters.summary: City buttons, + to add any city, today's weather and the next three days, and a 3D chart of each city's year, from the public Open-Meteo API.
starters.live_api: Open-Meteo (no key; free tier is for non-commercial use)
starters.manual_check: 3 cities to start. Open 'the raw forecast data' link and compare today's temperature with the page. In the 3D chart, point at Princeton's July bar: 79°F.
later_ideas: Add a switch between Fahrenheit and Celsius
Add a "what to wear" tip that follows the temperature
Show sunrise and sunset times
Draw a simple chart of the temperature across the next few days
Add tabs for today and the rest of the week
starters.try_it: Try it: press + to add your home city, then drag the 3D chart to turn it.

starters.title: Princeton Map
starters.summary: Princeton's sights on a map: choose a pin to read about it, filter by type, add your own place, and see the town in 3D.
starters.try_it: Try it: choose a pin, filter by History, then press 3D.
starters.manual_check: 18 places to start. Choose History: 6 pins and 6 cards stay. Press +, type a name and click the map: 19 places.
later_ideas: Add a walking route that joins three places in order
Add opening hours and a photo to each place card
Add a search box that finds a place by name
Show a chart of how many places each type has
Mark the places you have visited with a star

starters.title: Photo Studio
starters.summary: Pick a photo of a thing, place or pet, choose a style like watercolour or pixel art, and the workshop AI repaints it; save the best to a gallery.
starters.ai: Workshop picture model through the Website preview; photos of people, documents and screens are refused.
starters.try_it: Try it: pick the sleepy cat, choose Watercolour, and press Make it.
starters.manual_check: 6 pictures in the gallery to start. Make the sleepy cat into a watercolour and save it: the gallery shows 7.
later_ideas: Add your own style button, such as 'make it look like a postcard'
Show the newest picture large at the top of the gallery
Add a title box so you can name a picture before saving it
Add a slideshow button that shows the gallery one picture at a time
Add a favourite star to each picture and show favourites first

own_idea: Describe anything in one sentence, such as a team lunch planner, and get it built in the same style.
